title: Income Certificate
description: Official government document certifying the annual income of an individual or family from all sources. Essential for applying for scholarships, fee concessions, and welfare schemes.
eligibility: Resident of the state with demonstrable income details. Annual family income must be verified through income proof, salary slips, or self-declaration.
eligibility_criteria: Resident of the state with demonstrable income details. Annual family income must be verified through income proof, salary slips, or self-declaration.
required_documents_summary: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Salary Certificate / Income Self-Declaration, Passport Size Photograph

title: Domicile Certificate
description: Proof of permanent residence certifying that a citizen permanently resides in the state. Required for admissions in educational institutions and state government jobs.
eligibility: Must have resided continuously in the state for a minimum of 5 years.
eligibility_criteria: Must have resided continuously in the state for a minimum of 5 years.
required_documents: Proof of Residence (Electricity Bill / Water Bill)
School Leaving Certificate / Property Tax Receipt
required_documents_summary: Aadhaar Card, Proof of Residence, School Leaving Certificate, Passport Photograph

title: Caste / Community Certificate
description: Official certificate confirming that a citizen belongs to SC, ST, OBC, or BC community. Provides access to reservation benefits in education, jobs, and government subsidies.
eligibility: Citizen belonging to recognized SC/ST/OBC/BC categories as notified by the state government.
eligibility_criteria: Citizen belonging to recognized SC/ST/OBC/BC categories as notified by the state government.
required_documents_summary: Aadhaar Card, Parents Community Certificate, Ration Card, School Transfer Certificate

title: Birth Certificate
department_name: Department of Public Health & Preventive Medicine
description: Legal document establishing a person's birth date, birth place, and parentage. Crucial for school admissions, passport, and identity proofs.
eligibility: Event of birth must have occurred within the municipal or panchayat jurisdiction.
eligibility_criteria: Event of birth must have occurred within the municipal or panchayat jurisdiction.
required_documents_summary: Hospital Birth Report, Parents Aadhaar Cards, Marriage Certificate

title: Death Certificate
department_name: Department of Public Health & Local Administration
description: Official record stating the date, cause, and location of a person's death. Required for inheritance claims, life insurance, and bank account settlement.
eligibility: Family member or relative reporting death occurred within the local administrative area.
eligibility_criteria: Family member or relative reporting death occurred within the local administrative area.
required_documents: Hospital Death Summary / Medical Attendant Certificate
required_documents_summary: Medical Death Certificate, Deceased Aadhaar, Applicant ID Proof

title: Disability Certificate & UDID
department: Department for Welfare of Differently Abled
department_name: Department for Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
description: National Unique Disability ID (UDID) card and medical certificate specifying the percentage of disability. Grants access to travel concessions, monthly pensions, and assistive devices.
eligibility: Person with benchmark disability of 40% or more certified by a competent medical board.
eligibility_criteria: Person with benchmark disability of 40% or more certified by a competent medical board.
required_documents_summary: Aadhaar Card, Medical Board Assessment Report, Passport Photograph
validity: Permanent / Renewal based on disability type

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
department_name: Department of School Education & Social Welfare
description: Financial assistance scheme for students studying in Classes 1 to 10 from economically backward or reserved categories to reduce school dropout rates.
eligibility: Student in Class 1-10 with family annual income less than ₹2.5 Lakhs and minimum 75% attendance.
eligibility_criteria: Student in Class 1-10 with family annual income less than ₹2.5 Lakhs and minimum 75% attendance.
required_documents_summary: Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, School Bonafide, Student Bank Passbook

title: Post-Matric Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Financial support covering tuition fees and maintenance allowance for students pursuing Diploma, ITI, Undergraduate, and Postgraduate degrees.
eligibility: Enrolled in recognized post-secondary institution, family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs per annum, minimum 60% in previous exam.
eligibility_criteria: Enrolled in recognized post-secondary institution, family income under ₹2.5 Lakhs per annum, minimum 60% in previous exam.
required_documents_summary: Income Certificate, Community Certificate, Fee Receipt, Marksheet, Bank Passbook

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
service_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
department_name: Department of Social Welfare & Nutritious Meal Programme
description: Monthly financial pension assistance provided to elderly citizens living Below Poverty Line (BPL) to support basic sustenance.
eligibility: Senior citizen aged 60 years or above, belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
eligibility_criteria: Senior citizen aged 60 years or above, belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
required_documents_summary: Aadhaar Card, BPL Ration Card, Age Proof, Bank Account Passbook

title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
service_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension assistance for destitute widows to provide social dignity and economic independence.
eligibility: Widowed female aged between 40 and 79 years from a BPL household.
eligibility_criteria: Widowed female aged between 40 and 79 years from a BPL household.
required_documents_summary: Aadhaar Card, Husband Death Certificate, BPL Card, Non-Remarriage Declaration, Bank Details
validity: Until Remarriage or Age 80 (transition to Old Age Pension)
